name: rsx
description: Language support for .rsx templates: highlighting, diagnostics, hover, completion and go to definition.

rsx.server.path.description: Path to the rsx binary that provides the language server.

rsx.server.enabled.description: Run the rsx language server. Turn this off to keep syntax highlighting only.

rsx.rustAnalyzer.enabled.description: Answer questions about Rust expressions by consulting rust-analyzer. Turn this off to use template-only completion and hover.

rsx.rustAnalyzer.path.description: Path to the rust-analyzer binary used for Rust expressions inside templates.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting works in a restricted workspace. The language server is not started until the workspace is trusted, because it runs a binary whose path can be set by workspace settings.
